scripts.build.dev: rimraf build && npm run tsc && npm run copyConfigs
scripts.build.prod: rimraf build && NODE_ENV=prod npm run tsc && npm run copyConfigs
scripts.start.prod: npm run build.prod && npm run serve.prod
scripts.test: npm run test.poi && npm run test.context && npm run test.tool && npm run test.layer
scripts.test.tool: NODE_ENV=test babel-tape-runner ./build/tool/*.test.js | tap-spec && NODE_ENV=test babel-tape-runner ./build/toolContext/*.test.js | tap-spec
scripts.test.layer: NODE_ENV=test babel-tape-runner ./build/layer/*.test.js | tap-spec && NODE_ENV=test babel-tape-runner ./build/layerContext/*.test.js | tap-spec
scripts.test.context: NODE_ENV=test babel-tape-runner ./build/context/*.test.js | tap-spec && NODE_ENV=test babel-tape-runner ./build/contextPermission/*.test.js | tap-spec
scripts.initDB: npm run build.dev && rimraf igo.db && node build/initDB.js
scripts.version: npm run changelog && git add -A CHANGELOG.md
